maddeler.e:
أتسايف (form VI)
# أَتَسَايَفُ (ʔatasāyafu) /ʔa.ta.saː.ja.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَايَفَ (tasāyafa)
# أَتَسَايَفَ (ʔatasāyafa) /ʔa.ta.saː.ja.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَايَفَ (tasāyafa)
# أَتَسَايَفْ (ʔatasāyaf) /ʔa.ta.saː.jaf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَايَفَ (tasāyafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
